title: lookout input health, version 1
description: lookout's own judgment of one expected input. An input's report about itself can lower this status but never raise it. Version 1 only ever gains fields, so a consumer should ignore any it does not know.

status.description: error: the input cannot be read, belongs to another input, or reports that it failed. degraded: it was read but cannot be trusted as complete. absent_by_design: the setting expects it to be absent.

reasons.description: Every cause that lowered the status; empty when it is ok.

fetched_at.description: When the source was last read successfully, where the input says.

schema_violations.description: One line per violation, saying what was wrong and, where the validator reports it, where in the file.

supplier_reason.description: The supplier's own explanation, passed through for people; null when it gave none or the file could not be trusted.
